description: This file defines a class WordListWriter responsible for writing a list of words and their frequencies into an XML format. It manages file creation, XML writing, and provides methods to add entries and handle exceptions.

classes.name: WordListWriter
classes.description: A class for writing word lists with associated frequencies into an XML format, managing file output and XML structure.

methods.name: WordListWriter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the writer with the output file, creating necessary directories and setting up XML writing.

methods.name: writeWordWithRuntimeException
methods.description: Static method to write a word and its frequency, wrapping IOExceptions into RuntimeExceptions.

methods.name: addEntry
methods.description: Adds a word and its frequency as an XML entity to the output.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the XML writer and outputs the total number of words written.

methods.name: calcActualFreq
methods.description: Calculates the actual frequency value based on word index and total words, capped at 255.
